claims.text: Pediculicides ⍉required, but often used if lice or nits on body hair or co-infestation w head lice, pubic lice or scabies; most often permethrin cream to the entire body for 8 to 10 hrs
claims.quote: While pediculicides are not required to eradicate body lice infections, they are often used if body lice or nits are found on body hair or if there is a co-infection with head lice, pubic lice, or scabies.[6] In these cases, pharmacologic treatment employs the same agents for pubic and head lice, most commonly permethrin cream applied to the entire body for 8 to 10 hours.

claims.text: Outbreaks (eg, unsheltered populations): oral ivermectin, 2 or 3 doses of 200 µg/kg 7 to 14 days apart, = effective
claims.quote: Oral ivermectin (2 or 3 doses of 200 µg/kg, 7–14 days apart) is effective
claims.locator: Body lice and scabies among unsheltered migrants (PLoS Negl Trop Dis, 2025)
